reader.requirement: At --std 85 CONTINUE, written anywhere an imperative or conditional statement may be, must have no effect on execution: no data change, no transfer, no condition; the 2023 AFTER ... SECONDS phrase does not exist at 85 and must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ContinueAfter2023: the AFTER ... SECONDS phrase is refused below 2023 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: BindContinue returns BoundNop for plain CONTINUE at every edition and StatementEmitter#Visit(BoundNop) emits nothing; the only edition test is the AFTER phrase gate.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for plain CONTINUE; the AFTER phrase is accepted only from 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf15_04 covers CONTINUE as a statement; not exercised: in IF/ELSE, ON SIZE ERROR, AT END/NOT AT END, EVALUATE WHEN, an inline PERFORM body, a paragraph body, two in a sentence, and the AFTER refusal

probes.expected: CONTINUE in every position changes nothing: A stays 05; ADD under ON/NOT ON SIZE ERROR CONTINUE still stores 06 and leaves 99 on size error; the inline PERFORM runs to K = 4; the READ status and record are those of the READ; control falls through each one

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: CONTINUE AFTER n SECONDS requires COBOL-2023 (targeting COBOL-85)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.9.4 GR1  (6.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: Plain CONTINUE binds to BoundNop and emits nothing, so it cannot change data or flow; the probes in every statement position printed the unchanged state, and the later edition's AFTER phrase is refused at 85.

refuter.evidence: rcont.cob (rcont-002) at --std 85 tried positions the reader did not: CONTINUE before and after another statement in one sentence (N1 01); CONTINUE as the ELSE of an inner IF in a nested IF without END-IF (N2 FELL, neither wrong branch); CONTINUE as SEARCH AT END (N3 index 4, no WHEN) and as a SEARCH WHEN imperative (N4 index 1); a paragraph whose only statement is CONTINUE, PERFORMed (N5 00) and as the first of a PERFORM THRU range (N6 01); a GO TO target paragraph beginning with CONTINUE (N7 END). Nothing changed data or flow. The 2023 AFTER phrase is the only later form, and the reader showed it refused. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.9.4 GR1 the text is in GR1.
